title: FCA: convention extraction + persistence
description:
## Parent

sutra/v1/5 — PRD: sutra v1 review intelligence engine

## What to build

Add `src/fca/` module implementing convention extraction. Extract and clean up NextClosure + implication mining from the spike (`src/bin/fca-spike.rs`). Build symbol-level formal context from tree-sitter parse attributes. Extract approximate implications at confidence >= 0.9. Filter known language-rule implications where feasible. Persist to SQLite `conventions` table with stable identity hashes (hash of antecedent + consequent), support count, confidence, first_seen, last_seen. Run extraction incrementally on each parse.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `FcaEngine` struct with `rebuild(symbols, attributes)`, `update_incremental(delta)`, `conventions()` interface
- [ ] `conventions` table in SQLite with id (hash), antecedent, consequent, support, confidence, first_seen, last_seen, suppressed
- [ ] Stable identity hashes: same implication produces same hash across rebuilds
- [ ] Incremental update: adding/removing a symbol updates conventions correctly
- [ ] Extracted conventions from sutra's own codebase match spike results
- [ ] Tests: fixture-based extraction, stable hash verification, incremental update

## Blocked by

- sutra/v1/6 — Schema migration runner (new table needed)

messages.author: codex
messages.text:
Codex adversarial review — request changes:

[high] Parse pipeline never persists extracted conventions (src/pipeline.rs). The FCA module is exported but never called from the parse path. Conventions table will remain empty.

[high] Incremental adds are not idempotent (src/fca/engine.rs:77-89). Replaying a delta doubles symbol entries, inflating support/confidence.

[medium] Missing `returns_self` attribute from spike vocabulary (src/fca/attributes.rs:35-48)."
